grade_rationale: 4 P1 findings (exceeds C threshold of max_p1=2). D is the catch-all for anything worse than C per inspector.config.yml grading rules. F reserved for exploitable auth bypass + critical domain failure.

summary.skip_reason: Backend (localhost:3001) and frontend (localhost:5173) were offline — dynamic mode requires live services

escalations.issue: Arbitrary file read and code execution via UI server
escalations.reason: RCE-class CVE — requires security team review and confirmation before deployment

escalations.issue: Arbitrary code execution via .proto file parsing in live orchestrator
escalations.fix: npm install protobufjs@>=7.5.5 (solo session required — platform/ is solo-session only)
escalations.reason: RCE in production orchestrator infrastructure — highest priority escalation

escalations.issue: Missing buffer bounds check in v3/v5/v6 UUID generation in production backend
escalations.reason: Buffer vulnerability in production backend dependency — security team confirmation required

p1_findings.title: GET /api/search route unregistered — DependencyPicker typeahead silently broken
p1_findings.exploit_scenario: User types in DependencyPicker → GET /api/search → 404 (unregistered) → silently swallowed → empty results with no user feedback
p1_findings.impact: FR-dependency-search (cross-entity typeahead) is non-functional in production. Silent suppression means defect is invisible to users and testers.
p1_findings.recommendation: Register GET /api/search?q= in Source/Backend/src/app.ts; implement route handler; remove intentional-failure note in search.test.ts; remove catch suppression in DependencyPicker.tsx

p2_findings.title: Traceability enforcer silently ignores 7/8 plan requirements files (124 FRs unchecked)
p2_findings.recommendation: Update CLAUDE.md gate to: for f in Plans/*/requirements.md; do python3 tools/traceability-enforcer.py --file "$f"; done — or mark deferred plans explicitly

p2_findings.title: OpenTelemetry tracing not implemented — required by CLAUDE.md non-negotiable architecture rules
p2_findings.recommendation: Add @opentelemetry/sdk-node >=0.75.0; inject trace_id/span_id into log entries; add W3C traceparent middleware in app.ts

p2_findings.title: Logger always emits raw JSON — no development pretty-printing despite CLAUDE.md mandate
p2_findings.recommendation: Add NODE_ENV !== 'production' branch in emit() function to pretty-print logs in dev mode

p2_findings.title: brace-expansion <1.1.18 — 4 DoS CVEs (exponential expansion, OOM, zero-step sequences)
js-yaml <=3.15.1 — 3 DoS CVEs (merge-key chains, omap resolution, quadratic CPU)
browserslist <=4.28.6 — 2 DoS CVEs (unbounded memory growth OOM, prototype write crash)
vite <=6.4.2 — 3 CVEs: fs.deny bypass on Windows, NTLMv2 credential leak, symlink traversal
ws >=8.0.0 <8.21.0 — Memory exhaustion DoS via fragmented WebSocket frames
@grpc/grpc-js 1.14.0-1.14.3 — 2 CVEs: server crash on malformed request/message
p2_findings.fix: npm update @grpc/grpc-js@>=1.14.4 (solo session for platform/; TheFixer for portal/Backend)

p2_findings.title: path-to-regexp <0.1.13 — ReDoS via multiple route parameters
p2_findings.fix: npm update path-to-regexp@>=0.1.13 (solo session — platform/ is solo-session only)

p2_findings.title: @opentelemetry/auto-instrumentations-node <0.75.0 — Prometheus exporter crash on malformed HTTP
p2_findings.fix: npm update @opentelemetry/auto-instrumentations-node@>=0.75.0; also implement OTel SDK in Source/Backend to satisfy QO-003

p3_findings.title: Workflow route catch blocks bypass Express error middleware (7 locations in workflow.ts)
p3_findings.recommendation: Replace direct res.status(500) with next(err) in all 7 catch blocks

p3_findings.title: eslint-disable suppressions lack justification comments (2 instances)
p3_findings.recommendation: Add inline comments explaining why exhaustive-deps suppression is correct

p3_findings.title: Duplicate test files for WorkItemDetailPage and WorkItemListPage
p3_findings.recommendation: Consolidate into tests/pages/ variants; delete root-level duplicates

p4_findings.title: Silent catch on JSON parse in api/client.ts:26 — intentional but undocumented
p4_findings.recommendation: Add comment: // JSON body may be empty on 5xx from proxy/load-balancer; fallback to {}

cross_references.single_fix: Add @opentelemetry/sdk-node >=0.75.0 and implement OTel tracing in Source/Backend — satisfies CLAUDE.md rule and patches DoS CVE
Register GET /api/search in app.ts and consolidate tests/pages/ test file — fully operational search with one PR
Single npm update in Source/Frontend/ resolves all four findings
Solo session npm update in platform/orchestrator/ resolves all three findings
